scope: Complete staged style-hook selection, cached ownership handling and unchanged full-CI/mechanical rules

reviewed_boundaries.result: Hook passes no positional filenames, is always-run and serial, and selects --staged. This prevents pre-commit filename batches overwriting a prior failure report with a later passing batch.

staged_files reads Git cached ACMRT name-only paths with NUL separators, rejects unmerged entries, and run_checks rejects positional subsets before selection. Deletions are omitted from content reads while cached ownership diff still includes deletion/rename context.

Cached rename detection tests original owned paths against the trusted base ownership manifest, so staged old-path deletion cannot hide a move outside ownership. Existing tracked-source classification, nonempty owned set and sealed baseline checks remain enforced.

NEXUS_STYLE_FULL=1 and --all still request full owned-source checks. Control-file changes still force full checks. Report input_files, selected_files and selection_scope expose the chosen scope without changing mechanical format/comment/text rules.

--staged selects index paths and deliberately does not implement checkout/stash logic. Actual pre-commit provides its existing staged working view; real-hook tests verify bad staged bytes cannot be hidden by a clean unstaged copy and a clean staged copy preserves unstaged edits.

owner_evidence_observed.red: Eight genuine staged selection/hook failures plus one unmerged-index failure retained at red-source/red.log and unmerged-red.log.
owner_evidence_observed.green: final-green-command.json rc0 binds all three final SHA before/after; final-green.log reports 99 tests OK without skips.
owner_evidence_observed.portable_final: Final rename cases use a space; POSIX odd-name cases retain newline/tab coverage. Older test-source freeze and execution remain historical.

limits: Read-only corrective delta review, not execution of the root normal hook or clean CI checkout.
Standalone --staged without the pre-commit staged byte view is not claimed to independently materialize index blobs.
No Git HEAD/index/source changes were made by this reviewer; no checks, ownership gates or sealed debt rules were disabled.
